case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests frequently praised the hotel's location, surroundings/gardens and friendly, welcoming staff; several reviews also commended food/breakfast and pet‑friendliness or on‑site spa/bicycles. Recurrent negatives included outdated or run‑down facilities, maintenance problems (poor lighting, weak Wi‑Fi, low shower pressure, TV issues, pillows/mattress), and occasional noise. Isolated comments noted a bathtub leak/unsafe clips, a repaired cistern, unavailable spa slots, and reported fire‑safety non‑conformities.
